title: State machines & time travel
lead1: Extract "who can transition where" into one state table; illegal transitions are blocked in
lead2: itself, so no ifs across business code. Add an undo stack and you get time travel for free (undo / redo / jump).
grayHint: A grayed button means the action is not allowed in the current state — the machine returns ok:false directly, no re-check needed.
travelTitle: Time travel: undo / redo / jump anywhere
travelHint: The history stack stores a sequence of state snapshots. Committing a new state while not at the end discards the later redo branch — standard undo-stack behavior.
